title: Adina Beg Seeks Alliance with Wadbhag Singh

blocks.text: Adina Beg is shown as politically strained and unable to recover his position through ordinary means alone. His advisers therefore push him toward alliance with Wadbhag Singh, recognizing that strength now lies in coalitions forged from shared grievance as much as from state office.

The page also explains why such a partnership is plausible from the other side. Wadbhag Singh carries his own memory of violence and desecration at Kartarpur, so revenge and justice can converge with Adina Beg’s practical need for support.

Negotiation follows from that overlap of motives, and the account keeps alliance with Wadbhag Singh at the center of the page. The episode thus opens by showing politics rebuilt through injury, ambition, and careful approach rather than through inherited stability.
